_note: Frozen-source regression baseline for scanner-sarif-projection.ts. ONE pinned vNext Slither run on 17d55934 (identical to CI: 79 contracts, 102 detectors, 295 results; generate-scanner-evidence.ts --validate AND --check reproduced the committed SCANNER_EVIDENCE.json byte-for-byte from it). Trimmed to the fields scanner-finding-identity.ts and the projection read, exactly like the other fixtures here: filename_absolute/filename_short/is_dependency/start/length/columns, parent source_mapping and additional_fields are dropped; a contiguous line array is stored as the STRING "first-last" (a non-contiguous one stays an array, so the two cannot be confused); element fields are flattened to {type,name,file,lines,signature?,parent?}; parents keep {type,name,parent?}. Byte-identical findings are stored ONCE in `bodies`, and `order` lists the body index of each of the 295 results in Slither's emission order. `sarifHeader` is Slither's SARIF with results emptied. The test rebuilds Slither's SARIF from these findings and asserts its sha256 equals provenance.rawSarifSha256 -- the fixture is proven faithful rather than asserted to be.
